name: What is the difference between an attached and a freestanding covered patio?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an attached and a freestanding covered patio?

acceptedAnswer.text: An attached covered patio shares one or more walls with your existing home, often using the house structure for support. This design typically offers a seamless transition from indoor to outdoor living and can be more cost-effective due to shared structural elements. A freestanding covered patio, also known as a pergola or gazebo with a solid roof, is a separate structure built away from the main house. Freestanding patios offer flexibility in placement and can create a distinct outdoor zone, but may require more extensive foundation work.
acceptedAnswer.description: An attached covered patio connects to your home, while a freestanding one is a separate structure. Attached offers seamless integration; freestanding offers flexible placement.
